title: MacroPulse Alert
message:
BTC back above $84K — 4-day rally, ETF selling eases, shorts unwind. Recovery from $80.5K Oct low.
Sep CPI due Wed Oct 14 08:30 ET: consensus 3.7% YoY headline, 2.4% core. Last print before Oct 28 FOMC.
No price thresholds breached (BTC ~+1.4% 24h). API unavailable this run — prices via web search only.
